denominator_policy: Total-cohort rates count established successes over all cases. Conditional rates use endpoint-specific determinate cases: all candidates are adjudicated, or a known same-pose success establishes TopK. Undefined candidates can never manufacture failure or a success. All-full-coverage requires every evaluated candidate to have full scored-atom coverage.

protocol.foldbench: All 558 original interface IDs, raw/refined primary Top1 from N100, original OST2.8.0 BiSyRMSD<2A and LDDT-PLI>0.8. No PB conjunction. Full denominator plus defined-score rates and coverage. Holo redocking differs from native cofolding task and preparation.
protocol.openbind: Outcome-blind official 802-case follow-on subset, raw/refined Top1/5/25 from N100 and separately saved-prefix25 restriction. Original OST2.11.1 BiSyRMSD<=2A with all 27 official PoseBusters0.6.5 non-RMSD checks; additional endpoint requires same-pose LDDT-PLI>=0.8. Native preparation differences remain.
protocol.phibench: 206 locally selected released-archive cases; identity with the published 206 not established. Refined Top1/5, N100 and saved-prefix40 restriction. Fixed-receptor symmetry-corrected RMSD<2A, separately conjunction with all27 PoseBusters0.6.5 checks. Not relabeled published PAL-RMSD or native18-check PB conjunction.
protocol.selection: Frozen pRMSD, chirality eligibility, all-ineligible fallback, stable(score,index), eligibility applied within each prefix. Never fill missing eligible ranks with invalid candidates. No label-based selection, re-ranking, tuning, training or generation.
protocol.undefined_scores: Legitimate evaluator-unassigned scores remain explicit with all-complex denominator; runtime failures stop the shard. No outcome-based drop or retry.
protocol.prefix_budget: Restriction of saved N100 banks, not newly generated N25/N40 or an equal-compute comparison.

reference_annotation_sensitivity.scope: Descriptive secondary reference-annotation sensitivity, with metadata-defined subsets selected without outcomes. Reuses every original pose, selector and endpoint. All original cases remain in the primary denominators. Differences after exclusions are not causal estimates of coordinate imputation or a claim of identity with native PhysDock cases. Missing deposition metadata does not establish any actual deposition date. No new evaluation, training or generation.

repeat_definition: Three fixed-weight inference repeats; sample standard deviation.

native_both_metric_scoreable_subset.denominator: Both native RMSD and LDDT-PLI assigned on the same selected pose; outcome-dependent evaluator availability, not a common cross-model case mask.

reference_self_control_validation.policy: Identity and full coverage checked independently for each assigned reference-self metric. Only native FoldBench reference-self RMSD unassignment with the recorded binding-site reason is admitted; it is not imputed, reclassified as failure, or removed from the full cohort.

coverage_count_definition.partial_coverage_pose_count: Incomplete or unassigned structural-metric coverage; includes native unassigned metrics.
coverage_count_definition.rate_percent: Confirmed successful complexes divided by all complexes; unresolved endpoints remain explicit.
coverage_count_definition.defined_case_rate_percent: Success conditional on an endpoint being decidable, which can include a known failure with one unassigned component. This differs from the both-metric-assigned subset.
